name: What the Mind sees and does for one request
vision_statement: For one request the Mind works from one view of the information, breaks the request into pieces, hands a piece on only when a worker is needed, and writes the plan, request or communication its reader needs.
opportunities: What the Mind is shown, how it breaks a request into pieces and how it writes can each be improved on its own measure, and every handoff carries the person's authority and the done-standard of its sub-goal.
solution_coherence: Context Intake takes in what was prepared for a request and what the workers brought back, as one view. Planner breaks the request into pieces, each with the sub-goal it must meet. For each piece, Nervous System gives a risk signal before the piece is passed on. Judgment Calls then decides for the person whether to proceed or ask. Delegation passes each allowed piece to the worker its category names, only when a worker is needed, with the Representative's authority and the done-standard of the sub-goal. Response Writer writes the plan, request or communication from the results, to the quality profile.
